title: Rav Ukva bar Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Eruvin 34b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.34b.9): he raised an objection against Rav Nachman.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Eruvin names Rami bar Chama, or alternatively Rav Ukva bar Abba, as the person who challenges Rav Nachman. Hyman’s headword is Rav Ukva bar Chama.
